Intro: [Dm] / [Em] / ×2


[Dm]Baby, I'm in paradise,
[Em]like I'm hypnotized [Dm]when you touch my [Em]body.

[Dm]Baby, you're like kryptonite;
[Em]I'm falling from the sky, [Dm]coming down so [Em]easily.


*

[Dm]We drive around town; you're [Em]holding me now.
[Dm]You said you won't let me down; [Em]I'm so obsessed with that sound.

[Dm]The scent of your car is [Em]still lingering so far.
[Dm]You fill up my heart with the words
[Em]that come straight out of your mouth.


**

[Fmaj7]I can't deny [Em]I'm falling [Fmaj7]for [Em]you.
[Fmaj7]I can't deny [Em]I'm falling [Fmaj7]for [Em]you.

Woo, woo, woo—[Dm]baby, you might know [Em]it, right?
[Dm]Throw a stick into this fire;

[Dm]And... I close my eyes;
fill me up with those memories.

[Em]I smoke to choke the feeling
that you'll stay with me.

I hope you might feel me,
[Em]even in your dreams.

Tuning: E♭ Standard

songs.title: Have you ever
songs.tuning: Standard E A D G B E
songs.chordText:
Intro:
[Dm7] / [G7-9] / [Cmaj7] / [A7] / ×2


[Dm7]Walking down the streets so carelessly,
one misstep and you might [Cmaj7]fall—that's not all.

[Dm7]Walking down a path through danger's wrath,
you might end up [Cmaj7]gone—so gone, so long.


[F]Lonely times and [Dm]lonely signs;
it's [Am]easier to [A7]lie.


*

'Cause [Dm7]you—have you ever [G7]wondered
why the [Cmaj7]sea never cried for [A7]you?

When you speak of your [Dm7]dreams,
the sun is rising [G7]high,
but all I see are [Cmaj7]tears[A7].

Oh, [Dm7]you—have you ever [G7]felt so incom[Em]plete,
searching endless[A7]ly for the missing [Dm7]piece?

Wait a lit[G7]tle while;
it's gonna be all [Cmaj7]right[A7].


Instrumental:
[Dm7] / [G7] / [Em7] / [A7] / ×2


(Spoken)

“Gosh, there are so many things I want to tell you.
It's been pretty rough; I wish we had more time.”


[F]Lonely times and [Dm]lonely signs;
[Am]no one can hear, [C7]no one so dear.

[F]Too much to say;
[Dm]I'm fine, okay.
[Am]It's easier to [A7]lie.


Repeat: *


Instrumental:
[Dm7] / [G7-9] / [Cmaj7] / [A7] / ×2


(Spoken)

“You know what? Whenever I look at the stars,
I think of you.

I just hope you think of me too.
I'll see you again soon.”


Outro:
[Dm7] / [G7] / [Em7] / [A7] / ×4
